new_material_candidates.name: GATE — Graph-based Adaptive Tool Evolution Across Diverse Tasks
new_material_candidates.material_reason: GATE dynamically constructs and evolves a hierarchical graph of reusable tools across multiple scenarios, giving Task 8 a materially distinct tool-evolution comparator rather than another memory or skill-retrieval variant.

new_material_candidates.name: AgentFactory — A Self-Evolving Framework Through Executable Subagent Accumulation and Reuse
new_material_candidates.material_reason: AgentFactory stores successful solutions as executable Python subagents, retrieves and reuses them on later tasks, and refines them from execution feedback, a materially different persistent-capability mechanism from textual memories or skill documents.

reference_or_screened.name: SKILL0
reference_or_screened.relevance: Internalizes retrieved agent skills into model parameters through a curriculum that progressively withdraws skill context.
reference_or_screened.reason: The official repository states EMNLP 2026 acceptance, but this bounded review did not verify an archival EMNLP proceedings record. The method remains materially relevant research and must not be mislabeled.

reference_or_screened.name: Graph-of-Skills
reference_or_screened.relevance: Builds a dependency graph over skill documents and retrieves bounded structurally relevant skill bundles.
reference_or_screened.reason: Its principal intervention is retrieval and organization of an existing skill library rather than a standalone learned agent policy.

reference_or_screened.name: Skill1
reference_or_screened.relevance: Trains one policy to jointly select, utilize, and distill skills through a shared task-outcome reward.
reference_or_screened.reason: No archival peer-reviewed publication was verified in this bounded pass; preserve without fabricating publication status.

reference_or_screened.name: AutoSkill
reference_or_screened.relevance: Extracts reusable skills from interaction experience and supports replay, mutation, evaluation and promotion.
reference_or_screened.reason: Useful implementation evidence, but archival peer review was not verified in this pass.

reference_or_screened.name: Trace2Skill

reference_or_screened.reason: No archival peer-reviewed venue was verified in this bounded pass.

n_h2_reference_research.name: GATE
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Evolves and reuses tools across multiple task scenarios.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: The evidence does not establish one learned decision mechanism transferring into E2 structured ML and E3 vision.

n_h2_reference_research.name: AgentFactory
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Accumulates and reuses executable subagent capabilities across related tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Executable portability is not evidence that the same learned decision policy transfers across Hetren environment families.

n_h2_reference_research.name: XSkill
n_h2_reference_research.relevance: Transfers accumulated skills and experiences across multimodal-agent tasks.
n_h2_reference_research.reason: Cross-task multimodal-agent generalization remains inside the agent decision family.

stopping_rule.reason: GATE and AgentFactory are materially distinct, peer-reviewed, reproducible E1 candidates absent from the prior governed candidate identities and can alter the applicable retained comparator set.
